name: hungary-einvoice
description: Hungarian invoicing and real-time invoice data reporting to NAV (Online Számla) for tax year 2026. Covers who must report (every invoice and invoice-equivalent document issued under Hungarian invoicing rules: B2B, B2C, EU and export, but not OSS or IOSS supplies), immediate machine-to-machine reporting from invoicing software under NGM decree 23/2014 13/A. §, the 24-hour and 48-hour outage rules, printed invoices within 4 days or by the next day at HUF 500,000 VAT, the Online Számla 3.0 schema and API (token, 100 invoices per request, SHA3-512), the optional e-invoice delivered through NAV (completenessIndicator), invoice content and issue deadlines (Áfa tv. 163., 169. §), e-receipts and receipt reporting from 1 September 2026, retention, and the fines in Art. 220., 228. and 229. §. Trigger phrases: NAV Online Számla, online számlaadat-szolgáltatás, RTIR Hungary, invoiceData.xsd, ManageInvoiceRequest, completenessIndicator, e-nyugta. Out of scope: hu-vat-return (rates, returns), hungar
